g.text: P1-212 BIN SCREW FEEDER: DRAWING SET
Down Home Creole · Phase 1 · P1-212 Bin screw feeder (built in house, 9 off) · rev B
Product contact: ID Ra ≤ 0.8 µm [32 µin] (A270 S2 tube); welds ground flush; passivate ASTM A967
UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR ±0.5 [±.02] · HOLES +0.2/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · MACHINED X.X ±0.1, X.XX ±0.05 · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5

svg.text: Bin screw feeder P1-212, built in house, 9 off, rev B
2.5 in sanitary barrel, Ø56 screw supported both ends, 398 L/h fast / 6 g/s dribble, 0.25 kW gearmotor on Modbus drive, tool-free inside, screw pulls out the tail end
dose one ingredient at a time from bin B0n into the weigh hopper P1-220 (DosingStation.st)
ASTM A270 316L 2.5 in x 16 ga, ID Ra ≤ 0.8 µm, 1,195 flange to tail
Ø56 x pitch 56 x 3 formed flight on Ø25 shaft, RH, clearance 2.1
drive pin in socket at the drive end, UHMW bush at the tail; no bearing in the product
NORD SK 072.1 0.25 kW i 10.25, B14 lantern, L-075 jaw coupling; GS21 drive, Modbus RTU
PTFE lip seal 20x35x7 + EPDM O-ring at the drive end; TC 2.5 in at the tail
bin flange 200 sq 4 x Ø11 on 160 sq; spout on R280 over the hopper lid; axis 1,526 AFF
isolator in sight with early-break aux; KM-DOS on E-stop; tail cap = tool-fixed guard
longer barrel (spout vertical over the lid), tail bush, drive cartridge, ring legs moved 15°
P1-212 BIN SCREW FEEDER: DRAWING SET
SECTION A-A, DRIVE END AND TAIL END DETAILS
DRIVE END: HOUSING, DRIVE SHAFT, SPACERS
LANTERN WELDMENT, COUPLING GUARD, INLET GASKET
BOUGHT PARTS AND HARDWARE (PER FEEDER, 9 FEEDERS)
ELECTRICAL: FEEDER POWER AND CONTROL (TYPICAL n = 1..9)
ELECTRICAL: WIRE LIST, ISOLATOR TERMINALS, DRIVE SETTINGS
INSPECTION AND TEST PLAN, DESIGN CALCULATIONS
1. Units mm [in]. Third-angle projection. Tolerances in the title block unless noted. Weld symbols AWS A2.4; welding to AWS D18.1 / ASME BPE MJ.
2. Product-contact parts 316L / 316, Ra ≤ 0.8 µm, welds ground flush, passivated ASTM A967. Seals and plastics FDA 21 CFR 177.
3. Cut files (DXF) in dxf/ in mm and inch; 3D: cad/ (STEP per part, P1-212-ASM.step/.glb); generator: design.py, model.py, sh_*.py.
4. Bought parts marked 'confirm' must be checked against the supplier drawing before the matching made part is cut (gearmotor flange, drive model).
5. Release for build: drawings checked, ITP P1-212-900 attached to the traveler, materials certified.
